title: Denise NDE 21249
content: I was driving after 2:00 in the morning and I hit a telephone pole. My car was totaled. When the fire department showed up, I was dead. I thought I was dreaming, because I could hear them talking. I heard one of the firemen say I was gone! I started floating. I could see the fireman trying to save me. I was all bloody. I was above my body watching everything! I started floating higher. I had never felt so peaceful! It is the best peace you could ever wish for! I was floating into some clouds. I saw my family and others I didn't know, but somehow I did know them. There was a bright light, and many people. Everybody was standing in the clouds and smiling. I felt peace. The place was so pretty and peaceful. I was floating into a light, but my father, who had passed away when I was fourteen years old, told me it wasn't my time yet, and he loved me, but for me to go back! The next thing I remember is that I woke up in the hospital. The firemen joked around with me all the time, calling me the walking dead! But things after that started to get strange. When I was little, I used to see things that no one else could see. For example, an old woman named Mrs. Rice passed away, but I kept seeing her. And I had dreams and sometimes they would come true. But now I hardly sleep at night because, when I dream, most of my dreams come true! I had a dream about the hurricane that hit Louisiana last year. The only thing that was wrong was the name. I thought it was going to be Jose but it was the next one! When I get around people, I can sense if they are going to pass away! Everybody likes me; spirits come to my home and visit with me all the time. I know things before they happen, because I dream about them ahead of time. What has been bothering me lately is that I am seeing the number fourteen and this is a constant thing! And I know it means something! There is a Heaven! That I do know!

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Yes Accident Clinical death . I was dead twenty minutes upon arrival to hospital.
elements.The experience included: Out of body experience | Presence of deceased persons | Light | Special Knowledge | Vision of the future
elements.Did you feel separated from your body?: Yes I was above my body, floating and watching everything.
elements.At what time during the experience were: I knew what was going on, but I thought I was dreaming.
elements.Did time seem to speed up or slow down?: Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning The twenty minutes that my heart wasn't beating, seemed like slow motion. Like I was gone a long time.
elements.Did your hearing differ in any way from: A lot of people talking from far away.
elements.Did you pass into or through a tunnel?: Yes It was clouds. A pathway to Heaven!
elements.Did you encounter or become aware of any: Yes I know I saw my family that passed away. Also other people and something else.
elements.Did you see an unearthly light?: Yes A very bright light, but the light did not hurt my eyes.
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: My past flashed before me, out of my control After the accident I could turn the radio off and on only using my mind.
elements.Did scenes from the future come to you?: Scenes from the world's future Most of the time.
elements.Did you have a change in your values and: Yes I know there is a heaven and when your body dies your soul lives on! Your body is a casing of your soul!
elements.Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or: Yes I could move things back then, and my dreams are all mostly true now.
elements.Are there one or several parts of your e: The best part was the peace, and the worst was waking up.
elements.Have you ever shared this experience wit: Yes They loved me talking about it.
